responsibility: This file provides shared low-level code generation helpers used while lowering D frontend trees to GCC trees. It translates D source locations into GCC `location_t`, determines declaration and type contexts for nested and aggregate members, computes effective parameter and declaration types including D-specific lazy/ref/va_list adjustments, and owns the machinery for nested-function frames and closures: building frame record types, deciding whether a function needs a frame or heap closure, initializing closure contents, and finding outer frame references for nested accesses.
